resources.string: Nexote keeps your notes as Markdown files in a folder on this phone. Other apps can open them too, and you can back them up or sync them like any other files.
Nexote needs access to all files to read and write the notes in this folder. Android opens a settings page next: turn on access for Nexote, then come back.
Nexote needs access to your files to read and write the notes in this folder.
Nexote can\'t use the folder without access to your files.
Choose a folder on the phone\'s storage or on an SD card. Folders from other apps or cloud storage can\'t hold Nexote\'s files.
